explanation: API-style lemma, proved from Sylvester–Schur: for k > 0 some n works, so f(k) (a Nat.find) is well-defined. Erdos961Prop k n correctly says every n consecutive integers ≥ k+1 contain one with a prime factor > k (not (k+1)-smooth in Mathlib's convention). Correct and consistent with erdosproblems.com/961.
